verdict.rationale: The evidence shows versioned API documentation: llms.txt lists separate v2 and v0 doc sets, and the API reference paths are under /v2/. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or migration guarantees between versions. missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, explicit API versioning semantics (header or path guarantees), migration guidance between v0 and v2, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The [Internal Transfer API](/v2/reference/createinternaltransfer) allows you to transfer funds between two Synctera accounts, in real-time.
